data.body: Root cause confirmed: add_dependency refused every relation from a closed source (guard arrived unchanged in the DSO extraction b534f47a7f9, no rationale), while close_disposition.replacement_of accepts any non-archived/non-deleted replacement (deliberate, eaa9/738a/fc20/111a). Failing-first tests reproduced it (4 red on the closed-source refusal). Fix narrows the guard to allow supersedes only; blocks/depends_on still refuse. Pushed as Gerrit change 3159 (patch set 1, 16a5c02). Local: make lint + make typecheck pass; 1302 tests in the affected suites pass.
